newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakura says plans financial help to Green Cross.
newsitem.headline: Sakura says plans financial help to Green Cross.

text.p: Sakura Bank Ltd said on Friday that it and some other banks are planning to provide financial assistance to drug maker Green Cross Corp.
"We are planning to provide funds to Green Cross to redeem convertible bonds," a Sakura spokesman said, without elaborating.

The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Friday the bank was likely to provide several billion yen worth of loans to Green Gross, which the drug maker would use for bond redemption and capital investment.
The drug maker is suffering from an HIV scandal connected to some of the imported blood products it sold in the past.

Green Cross's business has suffered because of compensation payments to victims who contacted HIV from the tainted blood products, and a boycott of its products following the arrest of former Green Cross presidents in September on suspicion of knowingly selling such products.
